Common questions

Veterinary IT support FAQs

Do you support our practice management software?

Yes. We support the servers, networks and connections your practice management software relies on, for both cloud and on-premise systems, and we work with your software provider so issues are resolved quickly. Popular platforms such as ezyVet and RxWorks are examples of systems we support.

Can you manage and back up our imaging and x-ray data?

Yes. Imaging files are large and important, so we help make sure they are stored reliably, backed up and quick to open when a vet needs to review them.

How do you protect patient and owner records?

We apply layered security across your systems, devices and accounts, use tested backups, and follow good practice for handling sensitive records and payment information, along with staff awareness to reduce human error.

Can you support more than one clinic or branch?

Yes. We support single and multi-site clinics across NSW, VIC, QLD and WA with consistent security and one team you can call for every location.

Do you support both cloud and on-premise setups?

Yes. Whether your practice software and data sit on a local server, in the cloud, or a mix of both, we support the setup you have and can advise if a change would help.

What happens if our server or system goes down during consults?

Most issues are handled remotely so we can start immediately, with on-site support across NSW, VIC, QLD and WA when needed. We agree priorities with you up front so anything that stops you seeing patients is treated as urgent.
